beats.text: Story number three: at Pope Francis's funeral, a photo went viral, and the internet decided the president had dozed off.

beats.caption: Front row, eyes closed, head down -- and the internet ran with it.
beats.label: viral photo, via social media

beats.text: Trump sat beside Melania and Ukraine's Zelenskyy for the roughly ninety-minute Mass, and this is the frame that broke the internet.

beats.caption: Same moment, tighter crop -- this is the shot people couldn't stop reposting.
beats.label: viral photo, via social media

beats.text: Jimmy Kimmel didn't need convincing either.

beats.caption: The president either went deep in prayer or deep asleep. I don't know.
beats.label: via Jimmy Kimmel Live

beats.text: Network pool cameras also caught him chewing gum through the service -- outlets noted it as its own break from Vatican decorum.

But here's the catch: Snopes says low-resolution livestream grabs and harsh shadows make it impossible to actually confirm he was asleep, rather than just bowing his head. That didn't slow the pile-on for a second.

beats.caption: Minutes later, wide awake and upright with the rest of the world leaders.
beats.label: pool footage
